contentText: Brazilian award-winning author and European correspondent Jamil Chade offers deep perspective on Trump's dramatic attack on Venezuela and ensuing abduction of Nicolás Maduro. He argues this has very little to do with democracy or human rights and is more about US strategic interests in Latin America and Venezuela’s vast natural resources. His analysis challenges dominant narratives and evokes a return to the brutal Cold War‑era interventionism in the Americas during the 1950's, '60's and '70's.
